packageRules.description: Hold express at v4 until app-server route naming (shell-packages/app-server/index.js, mountTemplateOf) can read Express 5 routers (path-to-regexp 8, no layer.regexp); re-enable when that support lands.
Move the Playwright container tag in visual.yml and @playwright/test in kit/package.json together: Playwright refuses to start when the browser image and the library differ.
